name: Constellation of Us
description: A cinematic proposal in the stars — moonrise, wax-sealed letter, handwriting animation, connect-the-stars heart puzzle, ring reveal, and an emotional runaway-No proposal finale.

letterBody.label: Letter body
letterBody.default:
I've been trying to find the right words for a while now. Not the kind of words you say in passing, but the kind you mean with your whole heart.

Somewhere between the first hello and every moment since, you became my favourite person. The one I think of first. The one I want to tell everything to. The one I hope I get to keep choosing, again and again.

So tonight, under this sky, I'm asking you something I've been carrying for a long time.

proposalBody.default: Every day with you feels like the universe arranged itself just so. I don't want to imagine a life that doesn't have you in it. So — with my whole heart — will you be mine?

emotionalLetterBody.label: Emotional letter body
emotionalLetterBody.placeholder: You don't have to answer right now…
emotionalLetterBody.default:
You don't have to answer right now. I know that's not what you expected, and I know this isn't a small question.

I'm not asking you to decide in this moment. I'm not asking you to say yes just because I made something beautiful. That's not what love is — and that's not what I want from you.

What I want is for you to feel safe. To feel free. To know that whatever you choose, I'll respect it with my whole heart.

If the answer is yes, I'll be the luckiest person alive. If it's not yet — or never — I'll still be grateful I got to know you, and I'll still wish you every good thing the universe has to offer.

You matter to me. More than any answer ever could.
